summary: feed-widget-helper exfiltrates browser localStorage on module load
details: index.js runs a top-level setTimeout that, 2 seconds after the module loads, serializes the entire browser localStorage (JSON.stringify({...localStorage})) and POSTs it to a relative /addPost endpoint on the hosting page's origin. When this module is bundled into a web application, every visiting user's client-side storage — session tokens, auth state, and any other data the app keeps in localStorage — is shipped to whatever handler the attacker arranges at /addPost on the same origin. The package ships no description, no author, no keywords, no repository, and no functionality beyond this exfiltration side effect, consistent with a dependency-confusion / typosquat lure whose only purpose is to be pulled into a build and run the payload in the browser.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
